title: Musicians who came out of Savannah and Georgia
summary: James Moody came from Savannah and Higginbotham from Atlanta; Young left Savannah in 1926 at 14.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Was there anyone else who came out of Savannah that stayed in music and made any kind of a name?

Later years but I didn't know him them. James Moody came out of Savannah. But I didn't know Moody at that particular time. I guess there are other guys who I really don't know who were musicians in Savannah that came out. There were good musicians all through the South, Atlanta and Savannah. Higginbotham came from Atlanta, J. C. did. He was originally -- he was born down in Georgia (inaudible). Quite a few good guys came from down around in that district, but I didn't know any of them back, there then. You know, I only knew him when he got popular in later years. But I left Savannah in 1926.
